propositions: The plan-review close gate demands a certified attestation for tickets closed as superseded, even though such tickets cannot pass review—the more correctly superseded they are, the more certainly review will block.
The gate function close_plan_review_gate_check does not receive the close disposition as a parameter, so it cannot exempt administrative closes even when backed by live supersedes/duplicates links.

Superseded and duplicate closes skip completion verification when a live link is present, but the plan-review gate ignores this evidence, creating an asymmetry between two gates at the same decision point.
Force-closing a superseded ticket (the only current workaround) strips the completion signature from its entire ancestor chain, degrading audit trails retroactively.
The administrative disposition classes were extended to task/story/epic tickets in commit fc20-2df1-426e-42ab, creating the first reachable case where this gate blocks link-backed closes.
